description:
Drinko helps you make better cocktails at home with classic recipes, bartending tutorials, and a smart cabinet to track ingredients.

Explore 140+ classic cocktail recipes and 40+ shots — from a Negroni and Old Fashioned to a Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito, and Gin Tonic — learn essential bartending techniques, save your favourites, and see what's already in your home bar and spirits cabinet before you shop.

Make it yours: add your own recipes with a photo, turn it into a sticker. Your favourites and settings sync with your iPhone and iPad with iCloud.

Drinko is built for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts who want to mix with more confidence, improve their technique, and stay organised behind the bar.
promotionalText: A fresh new Drinko for Mac: one streamlined window, stickers from your own cocktail photos, 36 new shots, and iCloud sync with your iPhone and iPad.
whatsNew:
A fresh new Drinko for Mac: everything now lives in one streamlined window, and your own cocktails can wear a sticker made from your photo. Plus 36 new shots.

New
• Add a photo to your own cocktails, turn it into a sticker, or pick a card colour
• 36 new shots, including the Ferrari Shot, plus Campari classics like the Milano-Torino and Garibaldi
• Favourites, recently viewed drinks and settings sync with your iPhone and iPad through iCloud
• File › New and View shortcuts to create cocktails and switch sections from the keyboard

Improved
• A single sidebar, library and detail view, with Remove Ads always one click away
• Redesigned library cards and cocktail pages
• Search by ingredient: type "gin" to find every drink that uses it
• Choose your recipe units in Settings
